devicesHelp: One row per tablet. Object ID: letters, digits, _ and -. REST tablets need host and port. MQTT tablets need the topic ID: the device name from FreeKiosk's MQTT settings, in any spelling; empty uses the object ID. It is stored in lowercase, other characters than a-z, 0-9, _ and - become _.
Name: Name
restApiKeyHelp: The key set in FreeKiosk under Settings → Advanced → REST API. Leave empty if none is set.
mqttHint: Enter this ioBroker host, the port, user and password in FreeKiosk under Settings → Advanced → MQTT. The broker runs only while at least one MQTT tablet is configured. Do not expose the port to the internet: the connection is not encrypted.
idError: 1-32 characters A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ or -, not info, unique regardless of case
hostError: Hostname or IP address, without http://, path or %
topicIdError: At most 64 characters; unique among MQTT tablets, regardless of case
baseTopicError: Required for MQTT tablets; no +, # and no / at the start or end
